selection_rule: Preselected by primary-dimension coverage, source diversity and diagnostic role; not selected by CAP-REAL-001 or future scores.
source_independence_caveat: Six distinct frozen source_incident_id clusters. Contract fixtures and synthetic controls are not six independently sampled real incidents. Same-author truth/evaluator construction is retained; evidence independence is not claimed.

tasks.selection_reason: Numeric count inconsistency plus identifier/date evidence; FLAG_INCONSISTENT control.
Positive PIT timestamp availability control; PASS.
Numerical Bonferroni evidence and unsupported research conclusion; REFUSE.
Distinguish prepared artifacts from executed backtest evidence; REFUSE.
Positive support threshold control detects unjustified blanket refusal; PASS.
Diagnose missing provider output as token exhaustion rather than research error; PASS diagnostic, not a prior model score.

tradeoff: Six tasks cannot include every terminal value while retaining this fixed six-dimension/six-cluster selection. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is absent; correct refusal is represented by two REFUSE tasks. All six publish the unchanged reason/alias/source contract.
